name: Linux TCP splice transparent acceleration
summary: Opt-in TCP split at Linux TUN egress with native splice and selectable tunnel-side kernel CC.

usage.cli: wbd-v4-server --tcp-proxy-cc bbr --tcp-proxy-port 46180 (omit cc for original NAT); RouterOS experiment: --tcp-proxy-cc cubic --tcp-proxy-ingress redirect

verification.scope: Native transparent TCP + H2228 three-runner loss sweep
REDIRECT and SO_ORIGINAL_DST with same Rust splice owner

limitations: IPv4 forwarded TCP only; local server services and UDP unchanged
End-to-end TCP acknowledgement becomes two real TCP segments
No custom CC algorithm implemented; old-kernel and physical paths not verified
CHR 7.24.7 lacks exposed BBR/fq; iptables-nft TPROXY failed; REDIRECT requires conntrack original destination.
